title: "The Price Manifests"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji weighed his escape route, a familiar dark iron token reflected cold light from the shadows at the ruins entrance—that was the distinctive mark of imperial dynasty secret agents."

text.content:
"The moment Chen Tianming dissolved, Chen Ji felt the aftershock of that power—yet what followed was not the anticipated peace, but a piercing agony that shot straight to his soul.

It was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye.

Like being locked onto by an invisible eye from existence high above the Nine Heavens, an icy chill rose along his spine. A faint cracking sound came from his chest, and looking down, the seal coiled around his meridians was disintegrating visibly."

dialogue.content: "（Bitter smile）They came faster than I expected... I thought I'd at least make it out of these ruins."

text.content:
"Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his right hand pressing hard against his chest. The shattering of the seal not only meant his fake death identity was about to be exposed, but more dangerously—the hidden connection between him and Chen Tianming was snapping.

That blurred image surfaced again: his sister Chen Nian imprisoned deep within the Holy Sect, clearer than ever before."

dialogue.content: "（Murmuring softly）Niannian... Big brother is coming for you right away..."

text.content:
"The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly violently trembled, and a piercing alarm rang through Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He quickly checked—heavenly fate value: 23 points, a sharp drop of fifteen whole points compared to before using Fate Writing.

And the power of the third page... was temporarily sealed."

dialogue.content: "（Voice of the remnant soul, with a hint of urgency）The third page's seal requires at least thirty heavenly fate points to unseal. Until then, you can only rely on the abilities of the first two pages—and each use will accelerate the seal's disintegration."

text.content:
"Chen Ji's gaze darkened. The abilities of the first two pages could only foresee one hour into the future, and now, in these ruins he was in, the presence of three factions was rapidly approaching.

He used the Tianji Record Fragment to sense—Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and... the aura of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, all coming for the刚才的异变."

dialogue.content: "（Cold laugh）Interesting, seems all factions can't wait to get a piece of the pie. Too bad... the thing you want is already in my hands."

choice.prompt: "The three factions were about to arrive, and Chen Ji had to decide before they arrived—whether to appear openly or slip away in the chaos?"

choices.description: "Continue maintaining the废物 persona, pretending to be an innocent disciple caught up in the upheaval, letting all factions continue to underestimate you while secretly observing their attitudes."
choices.visible_cost: "Must endure scrutiny and probing from all factions"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain identity concealment, buying time for subsequent schemes"
choices.risk_hint: "The aura of seal disintegration may be detected"

text.content:
"Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing his true qi fluctuations to the lowest. He took out a set of dust-covered servant disciple attire from his storage bag and deliberately smeared some ash on his face.

A moment later, a timid, cowering servant disciple image appeared in place."

choices.description: "Use Tianji Record foresight to find concealed routes out of the ruins, avoiding the imminent three-faction conflict."
choices.visible_cost: "Abandon possible intelligence and resources in the ruins"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve strength, avoid falling into three-way chaos"

text.content:
"Chen Ji didn't hesitate, turning to dart toward a hidden passage on the west side of the ruins. His movement was swift, yet he abruptly stopped at the corner—

At the hidden passage entrance, a figure was slowly walking out."

choices.text: "Set an ambush to strike one faction"
choices.description: "Use Tianji Record foresight to select a target and ambush them when they're alone, acquiring resources while weakening enemy forces."
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes heavenly fate value, may expose partial strength"
choices.visible_reward: "May capture enemy resources, improving own advantage"
choices.risk_hint: "The three factions may converge at any moment, timing is crucial"

text.content:
"Chen Ji stopped, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. He quickly ran through the strength comparison of the three factions in his mind, finally locking onto—the Xuanwu Sect disciple who was alone.

Han Lie's lackey, perfect for testing my newly comprehended killing move."

"However, regardless of what choice Chen Ji made, the crack in his chest seal was continuing to expand. A bizarre fluctuation emanated from him—though faint, it was enough to be sensed by敏锐的高手.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again:

"The aura of the Tianji Record cannot be completely concealed. Every bit the seal breaks increases the risk of detection.""

dialogue.content: "（Cold, sharp gaze）In other words... I must solve all troubles before the seal completely disintegrates, or I'll become the target of all?"
"More precisely—you need to find an ally powerful enough to share this risk before the three factions surround you. Otherwise, in your current state...（remnant soul voice low）certain death."

text.content:
"Several figures flashed through Chen Ji's mind: Su Qingyao—would she believe a废物 disciple has an异宝 aura? Ye Qing—Demonic Path Saint Maiden, but where is she right now?

And that blurred image: Chen Nian.

His sister's presence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight, but at this moment, he felt with absolute clarity—Chen Nian was nearby."

choice.prompt: "Seal disintegration accelerating, Chen Ji must choose before his identity is completely exposed—whether to seek ally protection or go all in?"

choices.description: "Su Qingyao is the only one who noticed Chen Ji's abnormality. Though she hasn't determined the truth yet, she might be the only person willing to believe him now."
choices.visible_cost: "Expose partial strength to Su Qingyao, may change her view of you"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain the protection and trust of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao's investigation may draw others' attention to you"

dialogue.content: "（Mental voice transmission）Su Senior Sister, it's me. I need your help... regarding Chen Tianming, regarding me, regarding the Tianji Record."

text.content:
"After sending the transmission, Chen Ji felt a wave of weakness—every time he used mental voice transmission, it accelerated the loss of heavenly fate value. But he didn't regret.

A moment later, a cool mental fluctuation responded—the unique reply style of Su Qingyao, carrying disbelief, yet also a trace of undeniable concern."

choices.description: "Demonic Path Saint Maiden Ye Qing's 'Demonic Mist' can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, but the cost is having to expose more cooperation intentions."
choices.visible_cost: "May owe the Demonic Path a favor, deepening entanglements with the Demonic Path"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Demonic Mist to conceal aura, extending identity secrecy time"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing's location unknown, may be too late"

dialogue.content: "（Mental voice transmission）Saint Maiden Ye, Chen has a deal to discuss with you. Regarding the continuation of... the prophecy you've always wanted to know."

text.content:
"After sending the transmission, Chen Ji felt a familiar energy fluctuation coming from the distance—Ye Qing's position was closer than expected.

A moment later, a bewitching figure appeared at the end of the hidden passage—the Demonic Path Saint Maiden Ye Qing. A playful smile hung at the corner of her mouth."

choices.description: "Depend on no one, use every means to survive in the夹缝 between the three factions, displaying true strength and strategy."
choices.visible_cost: "Heavenly fate value rapidly depleting, may透支生命力"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain absolute independence, all gains belong to self"
choices.risk_hint: "Once discovered, will face combined assault from all three factions"

text.content:
"Chen Ji closed all transmissions and walked alone into the depths of the ruins. His steps were steady, but his eyes were colder than ever.

Since heaven wants him dead, let heaven see—how Chen Ji carves a bloody path from this死局."

"Just before the three factions were about to arrive, Chen Ji suddenly felt that familiar fluctuation—coming from Chen Nian.

That was the unique aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, like a lighthouse lit in the darkness, guiding him forward.

Little sister... she's in the deepest part of these ruins!"

dialogue.content: "（Fists clenched tight）I said I'd come for you... whether it's a dragon's pool or a tiger's den ahead."

text.content:
"However, Chen Ji also felt three powerful auras approaching—those were the vanguard forces sent by the three factions, each at Foundation Building late stage cultivation.

Worse, he sensed an extremely familiar aura among them: Ling Yuan's shadow.

The old sect master... he really came."

choice.prompt: "Chen Nian's call was close at hand, but Ling Yuan's shadow was also closing in. Chen Ji had to make the final choice—chase after his sister, or deal with Ling Yuan, the greatest threat first?"

choices.description: "Little sister is Chen Ji's biggest weakness, also his greatest obsession. The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key may help him reverse the situation."
choices.visible_cost: "May fall into Ling Yuan's trap, caught between two forces"
choices.visible_reward: "Reunion with sister, obtain Heavenly Fate Lock Key power"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Nian's presence will interfere with Tianji Record foresight"

text.content:
"Chen Ji didn't hesitate anymore, turning to dart into the depths of the ruins. Chen Nian's aura grew clearer, and he could feel that Heavenly Fate Lock Key fluctuation resonating with the Tianji Record.

Yet what he didn't notice was that in the shadows behind him, a pair of murky yet sharp eyes were closely watching his back—the informant sent by Ling Yuan."

choices.description: "Ling Yuan is the Tianqing Sect's archenemy, also the biggest variable in Chen Ji's schemes. Seizing this opportunity to strike first may turn the situation around."
choices.visible_cost: "May miss the best timing to rescue Chen Nian"
choices.visible_reward: "Eliminate the greatest threat, consolidate position in Tianqing Sect"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan's strength is深不可测, may backfire"

text.content:
"Chen Ji stopped, a cold light flickering in his eyes. He turned, walking toward that familiar aura.

Ling Yuan, did you think I was still that废物 you could manipulate at will? Today, let you see—who is the true chess piece."

"Chen Ji's footsteps echoed in the depths of the ruins, each step treading on the blade of destiny. The crack in the chest seal grew larger and larger, the Tianji Record's aura leaking more and more.

He knew he had no retreat.

Either find Chen Nian before the seal completely disintegrates, using the Heavenly Fate Lock Key to reverse the heavens; or prove his true strength in Ling Yuan's encirclement—

Whichever choice, he would let everyone know: the era of废物 Chen Ji has ended."

"Just then, a commotion came from the ruins entrance. Chen Ji sensed with his remaining Tianji Record power—the three factions' forces had almost simultaneously arrived.

However, what truly made his heart sink was another aura.

That was the distinctive dark iron token aura of imperial dynasty secret agents, cold, sharp, like a venomous snake lurking in the night."

"The imperial dynasty... actually intervened.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his mind racing. What did the imperial dynasty secret agents' appearance mean? Were they here for the Tianji Record, or was there another purpose?

More importantly—would Chen Nian, as the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, also attract the imperial dynasty's觊觎?

Countless questions churned in Chen Ji's heart, but what mattered most now: he had to make the final decision before that figure discovered him."
